messages:
IncidentBot: 🔔 Incident alert: High error rate on /v1/generate (region: eu-west-1). Triggered by 5xx spike. Incident ID: INC-2026-0315-42
Maya Chen: oncall here — I'm looking, can someone start drafting customer-facing text? @Samir can you prepare a Zendesk macro?
Samir Patel: yep. preparing a short customer reply + one for engineering-followup. do we know impacted customers (billing tier / dedicated vs hosted)?
Jordan Kim: appears primarily hosted API keys hitting our large-batch path. Dedicated pools unaffected so far. I see KV cache misses spiking on one routing shard.
Maya Chen: Lia, any recent deploys to eu-west-1?
Lia Torres: no prod deploys in past 2 hrs. infra scaled normally. I pulled logs — looks like an internal routing agent restarted repeatedly (ops-agent-3). Restart loop correlates with error window.
Evan Barnes: copying a draft status page blurb for support to use: 

"We are investigating an issue affecting the Redwood hosted API in eu-west-1. Some requests to text generation endpoints may fail with 5xx errors or see increased latency. Our on-call team is actively investigating and working on mitigation. We will provide updates every 15 minutes. Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0315-42"

Samir Patel: Zendesk macros (short & long) — paste below, feel free to tweak. Use "Inc-2026-0315-42" tag in tickets.

Short macro (for immediate ack):
```
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

Thanks for reporting this. We're currently investigating an issue affecting the Redwood hosted API in eu-west-1 which may cause 5xx errors or latency. Our engineers are looking into it and we will follow up with more details within 15 minutes.

Incident reference: INC-2026-0315-42
Status page: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0315-42

— Redwood Support
```

Long macro (post-mitigation follow-up):
```
Hi {{customer.first_name}},

Update on INC-2026-0315-42: Our team has identified a restart loop in an internal routing agent that caused increased 5xx errors for some hosted API requests in eu-west-1. We deployed a targeted rollback and restarted the routing cluster; error rates have returned to normal as of {{incident.resolution_time}}.

Impact: Some hosted customers experienced failed requests and higher latency during {{incident.duration}}. If you saw persistent failures or missing responses, please reply and include sample request IDs.

Root cause: faulty process restarts triggered by an internal health-check regression. A follow-up postmortem will be published on our status page once complete.

Apologies for the disruption — let us know if you want a private postmortem or a technical call.

— Redwood Support
```

Maya Chen: great. Intercom quick reply variants? we need one that CS can paste into live chat.

Samir Patel: Intercom short: "Hi — we're investigating an issue impacting hosted API in eu-west-1. Some requests may fail; engineers are on it. Incident INC-2026-0315-42. Status: https://status.redwood.ai/incident/INC-2026-0315-42"

Jordan Kim: Ops handoff notes for SREs — put these in the incident channel and the runbook:
- current symptomatic behavior: 5xx on /v1/generate, KV cache miss rate +2.3x, routing agent restarts.
- immediate mitigation applied: circuit-break route to shard-3; rolled back routing-agent to v2.14.1; warm cache primed.
- suggested next steps: monitor error rate for 30m, validate end-to-end with curl test, collect traces for any lingering 5xx samples.

Code snippets to validate end-to-end (add to runbook):
```
# basic curl check
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-conditional-1","input":"hello"}' -v

# tail the routing agent logs (k8s)
kubectl -n redwood logs -l app=routing-agent -c agent --since=15m | grep ERROR | tail -n 50
```

Lia Torres: checklist for support agents to triage incoming tickets (compact):
1) Confirm customer region (eu-west-1?) and API key type (hosted vs dedicated).
2) Ask for sample request IDs or timestamps.
3) Check status page link and paste current incident line.
4) If dedicated/Reserved, escalate to Account Exec + Escalations (these customers have isolation).
5) If hosted + high severity, add note to incident Slack thread and assign to oncall.
6) Provide short macro and set ticket priority to P1/P2 accordingly.

Evan Barnes: adding Zendesk internal note template for engineers:
```
Internal: Ticket linked to INC-2026-0315-42. Customer reports X. Key checks: request_id, time window, client-region. Please attach stack traces and note whether request routed to shard-3. If resolved, include confirmatory logs and time window.
```

Samir Patel: quick CS script for phone/voice: "We're investigating a regional API issue (eu-west-1) causing 5xx errors; engineering is actively mitigating. We'll provide an ETA in ~15 minutes and follow up when resolved. Incident: INC-2026-0315-42."

Maya Chen: oncall handoff note (for next rotation):
- current status: mitigation applied, error rate down 80% in last 6m, still monitoring.
- followups: watch for regression after rolling routing restart at +30m, validate long-tail latency for >2s requests.
- contacts: Jordan (eng-sre) pager, Lia (infra), Samir (support lead).

Jordan Kim: logging pointers — when filing postmortem, collect: 
- routing-agent logs (-30m to +30m around incident)
- metrics: kv-cache-miss, request-latency-percentiles, provider-queue-lengths
- config diffs for routing-agent between v2.14.1 and v2.15.0

IncidentBot: Update: mitigation confirmed, error rate stable. Next automated update scheduled in 15m.

Samir Patel: copying sample 'intercom proactive message' we might send to impacted customers: 
```
Hi {{customer.name}},

We wanted to let you know about a recent issue that may have affected some of your requests to our hosted API in eu-west-1. Our engineers fixed the root cause and restored normal service. If you experienced failures in the past hour, please reply with request IDs and we'll investigate further.

Thanks for your patience — Redwood Support
```

Lia Torres: small ops note — pin the incident and attach the runbook link: https://internal.redwood.ai/runbooks/routing-agent-restarts

Evan Barnes: if anyone wants a condensed checklist card to paste into tickets, here's a 3-line version: 
```
1) Region & key type
2) Provide status page link + incident ref
3) Request sample request_id + escalate if dedicated
```

Maya Chen: perfect. I'll paste these into the incident command post and lock the thread for public edits. If anyone adds major changes, ping me. :lock: :raised_hands:

Jordan Kim: deployed rollback note added to incident timeline.

Samir Patel: I'll push the Zendesk macros live and add the short Intercom reply to the toolbar.

Maya Chen: thanks all — keeping this thread as the single source for support messaging. updating status page now.

OpsBot: System: Incident INC-2026-0315-42 moved to "Mitigated" at 2026-03-15T14:34:40Z.

Maya Chen: closing handoff: next update will be the postmortem draft in ~24-48h. If there are regression spikes, reopen channel immediately.

Evan Barnes: noted — will prepare the ticket rollup for impacted customers list.

Jordan Kim: ETA for postmortem first draft: 48 hours.

IncidentBot: Final automated message: Postmortem scheduled.
